item.title: Harder seeks 2-year ban on ex-CPUC members to be able to lobby for PG&E
item.description: Congress Josh Harder has introduced federal legislation aimed at reining in out-of-control rate hikes by shutting the revolving door in Sacramento between state regulators and PG&E lobbyists.

item.title: ROUNDUP: Manteca girls soccer coach earns 300th win
item.description: Justin Coenenberg tallied his 300th win as Manteca High’s girls soccer coach on Monday, and the Buffaloes did so in dominating fashion against visiting Patterson, 4-0. Manteca (5-1-2, 15-4-2 overall) exacted some measure of revenge after previously drawing with the Tigers (1-5-2, 4-9-3).

item.title: Sierra falls to opportunistic Oakdale
item.description: Sierra matched Oakdale’s level of play between the 18-yard lines in their Valley Oak League duel Monday at Daniel Teicheira Memorial Stadium. One team was far more efficient in the box, however, and that was the difference for the visiting Mustangs. Shelby Mitchell netted two impressive volleys, and Dakota Burford punctuated Oakdale’s 3-0 win with a sliding strike.

item.title: BACK IN BLUE
item.description: Ryan Teicheira is coming home. The 2001 Sierra High graduate has been hired to coach football at his alma mater, the school announced Monday.

item.title: SUBSIDIZED MANTECA COMPLEXES
item.description: Non-profit housing has been a solid partial answer for a perplexing problem facing Manteca — affordable workforce housing. The latest example is the 100-unit Bold Communities apartment complex now being built on North Main Street.
